notes: synthetic session: per-sender webhook rate limiting, cut at line 20

rows.content: The /hooks/billing endpoint is getting hammered by retries from the payment provider and our worker pool falls over. Add rate limiting per sender, something like 20 requests a minute, and return 429 with Retry-After when it trips.
I will look at how the billing webhook is routed and where a limiter can sit before the handler runs.

The route is registered in server/hooks.ts and the handler parses the body before any check. I will add a token bucket keyed by the sender id from the signature header, in a new server/rateLimit.ts, and call it first in the route.
Added server/rateLimit.ts with a token bucket (20 tokens, refill one every 3 seconds) and wired it into the billing route. Over the limit it answers 429 with a Retry-After header in whole seconds.
Keep the buckets in Redis, not in memory. We run four instances behind the load balancer so an in-memory limit is four times too loose.
Moving the buckets to Redis with a Lua script so the take-and-refill is atomic across instances.
The limiter now uses Redis with an atomic script. Typecheck passes. Next I will add tests.
Write a test that fires 25 requests from one sender and checks the last five get 429.
Added server/rateLimit.test.ts against a local Redis: 25 requests, the first 20 pass and the last 5 get 429 with Retry-After of 3.
The retry test in hooks.test.ts is flaky again, can you see why while you are in there?
The flaky test waits a fixed 100 ms for a retry that is scheduled with jitter up to 150 ms. I changed it to wait for the retry event instead of sleeping.
Good. Now make the limit configurable per sender, the big reseller account needs 200 a minute.
Added a per-sender override map loaded from config/rateLimits.json, defaulting to 20 a minute. The reseller entry is set to 200. Tests cover the override.
All limiter tests pass and the flaky retry test passed 50 runs in a row. The change is ready for review.

commits.message: Rate limit billing webhooks per sender
